subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should Telegram support a standalone processing-message lifecycle in addition to typing, acknowledgment reactions, status reactions, and streaming previews?
rationale: The requested capability is absent and technically feasible, but it introduces another visible feedback mode and a compatibility-sensitive configuration contract that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Telegram placeholder
options.body: Implement one channel-owned opt-in placeholder with success deletion and explicit failure edit-or-replacement behavior.

options.title: Design portable acknowledgment text
options.body: Coordinate this with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 and define a cross-channel presentation contract before implementing Telegram.

options.title: Keep existing feedback modes
options.body: Decline the additional message lifecycle and document typing, reactions, status reactions, and progress previews as the supported choices.

recommendation.title: Add Telegram placeholder
recommendation.body: Implement one channel-owned opt-in placeholder with success deletion and explicit failure edit-or-replacement behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is already connected to the issue review and recent history across the central Telegram processing and configuration files.
